notes.title: Release Candidate
notes.content:
[b]New Features: [/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple camera angles that can be switched during gameplay
[*] Key rebinding options
[*] Display options including screen resolution, global quality, refresh rate and windowed mode
[*] Translations for English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, German, Russian, French, Italian, Spanish
[*] Mission list to view in game objectives
[*] Steam achievements 
[*] Global and Local leaderboard system
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37311652/9f1217766e3fc37560940f47410e1034b1036673.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved music, fixed the volume bug
[*] Added more tunes
[*] Fixed the nudge/tilt, now has a 1 second gap between uses
[*] Fixed the ball getting stuck on Vegas
[*] Ability to control music and sfx volumes
[/list]
